## Actual commands and success boundaries

```bash
SDK=/your/external/cache/vision_sdk
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$SDK/components/qt/lib:$SDK/components/opencv/lib"
export PATH="$SDK/components/qt/bin:$PATH"
export QT_PLUGIN_PATH="$SDK/components/qt/plugins"
export QML2_IMPORT_PATH="$SDK/components/qt/qml"
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QSG_RHI_BACKEND=software QT_QUICK_BACKEND=software LANG=C.UTF-8
# optional to make Qt basic offscreen platform render Chinese correctly:
export AOI_M00_TEST_FONT_FILE=/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc
cmake -S . -B build/linux-sim -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
  -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$SDK/components/qt;$SDK/components/opencv" \
  -DAOI_SIM_ONLY=ON -DAOI_BUILD_GUI=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
cmake --build build/linux-sim -j 4
ctest --test-dir build/linux-sim --output-on-failure
python3 tests/integration/five_process_smoke.py --bin-dir build/linux-sim --evidence-dir /external/evidence
```

- CMake configure: exit 0; `cmake_configure_linux.log`.
- C++ build: exit 0; `cmake_build_linux.log`: built `aoi-core`, `aoi-ui`, `vplc`, `domain_contract_test`, `opencv5_link_probe`.
- CTest: **6/6 PASS, 0 FAIL**, see `ctest_linux_6of6.log`.
- Independent OS processes: 5 concurrent distinct PIDs in `test_evidence.json`; Core role isolation via separate SQLite WAL; two UI windows load actual Qt Quick QML and connect their respective Core via QLocalSocket IPC; vPLC responds on a real loopback UDP socket but **only to M00_HEALTH_V1, not FINS**.
- IPC request `write D1016 1`: returned `REJECTED`. Unknown UDP datagram: no response.
- Negative test: `AOI_SIM_ONLY=OFF` CMake returns exit 1 (expected rejection); `0.0.0.0` UDP bind rejected; invalid role and master/slave reused DB refused.
- ZIP patch roundtrip: verified allowed owned file patch + exact hash, refuses cross-owned edits and wrong WBS owner, refuses patch SHA against wrong base, refuses unverified prerequisite at integration, refuses ZIP path traversal; accepted test candidate explicitly marked `CANDIDATE_UNVERIFIED`.
- Screenshots `master_m00.png` and `slave_m00.png` are actual Qt Quick offscreen window captures. Font registration uses preinstalled system Noto CJK font **only inside local test**, font not distributed. Screenshot is only a scaffolding health UI, **not** the designed 11-channel quality UI.

## Clean ZIP check defect found and fixed

First clean-extraction Release CTest found one **test harness** defect: `tests/patch/test_zip_protocol.py` used `ignore_patterns('evidence')`, unintentionally deleting the immutable `docs/evidence/` subtree in its temporary copy; the patch validator correctly rejected the deletion of an unowned report. The source fixture copy filter was corrected to exclude generated `evidence/` only at repository root. This failure is not hidden: original clean first run was 5/6 PASS, with corrective repeat planned and verified in the external final receipt.
